A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TubeletGraph work. Their main text, equations, Figures 1–5, Tables 1–6, and Appendix A.1–A.5 are available and readable, supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original tracking evaluations, VOST-TAS state-graph results, component ablations, and threshold sensitivity experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical evaluations and reports revised numerical results in the main text and appendix.

M1.justification: Both versions use CropFormer/SAM2.1 tubelets, spatial proximity and semantic filtering, and VLM-generated state graphs. Section 3 clarifies terminology and notation without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate VOST, VSCOS, M3-VOS, DAVIS 2017, and VOST-TAS. VOST-TAS retains 57 video instances, 108 transformations, and 293 resulting objects; no task or domain coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains XMem, Cutie, ReVOS, SAM2, SAM2Long, SAM2.1, DAM4SAM, and SAMURAI. The fine-tuned SAM2.1 comparisons and component alternatives in Tables 1 and 3–5 also retain their membership.

E3.justification: Reported splits, sample sizes, model configurations, metrics, annotation and matching procedures, and threshold sweeps are unchanged. The numerical revisions are not accompanied by reported changes to experimental settings.

E4.justification: Tables 1 and 5 substantially revise the filtering ablation evidence: partition-only recovery changes from approximately maintaining or improving baseline IoU to severely degrading it across all three transformation datasets. Component ablation and threshold sensitivity results also change in Tables 3, 4, and 6. The questions tested and failure examples remain the same.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same paired t-test comparison in Section 4.1. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or uncertainty-estimation practice changes are documented; the revised p-values are result changes.

E6.justification: Partition-only VOST J/precision/recall changes from 48.3/62.6/65.0 to 25.7/18.6/71.5 in Table 1; partition-only J changes from 74.4 to 42.5 on VSCOS and 71.7 to 60.9 on M3-VOS in Table 5. Full-model changes are smaller: VOST J/Jtr moves from 51.0/36.9 to 50.9/36.7. Table 3 revises DINOv2 semantic accuracies from 81.0/83.3 to 76.2/77.1, and Table 6 updates sweep results. The J/Jtr p-values change from 0.026/0.008 to 0.014/0.013.

T1.justification: The task definitions, assumptions, filtering formulas, evaluation metrics, and overlap rules remain substantively unchanged. Completing the initial tubelet index with |E1| makes explicit what the existing prose already specified; it introduces no new mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: Track Any State and VOST-TAS, zero-shot TubeletGraph, strong transformation tracking, and transformation detection and description. The small wording edits do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 emphasizes a much harsher precision-recall tradeoff for unfiltered recovery and drops the assertion that adding semantics produces gains across all metrics. The underlying mechanism explanations, failure conditions, computational limitations, and Appendix A.5 discussions otherwise remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: Model specifications, hyperparameters, GPT-4.1 prompts and temperature, overlap handling, hardware/runtime information, and code/data access statements are retained. No implementation revision or explanation for the changed results is disclosed.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same works and research positioning. Removing repeated dataset citations in Section 4.3 changes citation backreferences without removing the cited works.

P1.justification: Localized edits clarify the initial object prompt, standardize tubelet terminology, and adjust the results discussion. Appendix A.5 reverses the order of the existing fine-tuning and occlusion paragraphs. The overall narrative and section structure are retained.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5 and the table structures are retained. Table 6 newly underlines the selected central parameter settings and explains this marking in its caption; other layout changes are limited text reflows.

improvement.justification: The notation clarifications and Table 6 markings modestly improve readability. However, the dominant revision replaces central ablation results with substantially different values without explaining a correction or experimental change. The PDFs do not establish whether this revised evidence is more reliable, so a net improvement in overall paper quality cannot be determined.
